section.p: This experimental shared package uses the same application on Touch HD 3, Verse Pro, Era and InkPad 4. Check the included guide for the exact firmware versions.
Open a book with CoolReader from the Library, or use Recent books. Your saved settings take precedence over the general defaults.
Use Settings > Check for updates for the shared update channel, and Version to see the installed release. Please report your model, firmware and the normal/crash logs when testing.
